name: Muro Takumi
source:
Occupation: Farmer
Stay as: Dweller

Takumi is an easy person to talk to who does all sorts of manual work around Yasumizu.

He lives in the house near the plaza of Yasumizu.

[Taken from the official art book included with the [url=/r65525]Day One Edition[/url].]
